Speaker A: Avunu nee job poyindanta kada. Nenu mundu nunchi cheptunnanu English sarigga nerchukomani. Manager kuda cheptunnadu nee English chala weak ani. Emails kuda rayalekapotunnavanta kada. [Yes, I heard you lost your job. I've been telling you from the beginning to learn English properly. Even the manager said your English is weak and you can't write emails.]
Speaker B: Ippudu em cheyali? Free YouTube classes chusanu, grammar kuda nerchukunnanu. Kani ippatiki English matladetappudu thappu chestune untanu. [What should I do now? I watched free YouTube classes and learned grammar, but I still make mistakes when speaking.]
Speaker A: Choodu, nuvvu tension padaku. Nenu fifteen to twenty days lo English baga nerchukunnanu. Nuvvu kuda alage nerchukovachu. [Don't worry. I learned English well in 15 to 20 days. You can too.]
Speaker B: Nijama? Intha thakkuva rojullo ela? [Really? How in such a short time?]
Speaker A: Choodu SpeakX ani oka app undi. Nuvvu fifteen minutes tea break teesukuntav kada, aa time lo AI teacher tho matladithe chalu. Nuvvu thappuga English matladina, thappuga pronounce chesina adi anni correct chestundi. Nee mother tongue tho paatu English kuda nerchukovachu. Choodu deenini oka question adugu. [There is an app called SpeakX. Just practice with its AI teacher during your 15-minute tea breaks. It corrects your pronunciation and grammar mistakes, teaching you English through your mother tongue. Ask it a question.]
Speaker B: Nenu kuda English matladatam nerchukovacha? [Can I also learn to speak English?]
AI (Sia): Haa, easy ye. Naatho prati roju fifteen nunchi twenty minutes practice cheyadam start cheyyandi. [Yes, it's easy. Start practicing with me for 15 to 20 minutes daily.]
Speaker B: Sare, nenu roju practice chestanu. [Okay, I will practice daily.]
AI (Sia): Say, "I will practice with you every day."
Speaker B: Okay, I will practice with you every day.
Speaker B: Bagundi, kani chala costly untundemo. [It's good, but is it expensive?]
Speaker A: Ledu, daani seven days trial kevalam two rupees ki dorukutundi. [No, a 7-day trial is available for just 2 rupees.]
Speaker B: Arey waah! Nenu ippude download chesukunta. [Wow! I will download it right now.]
Speaker A: SpeakX tho practice chey. Nee English fifteen days lo naalaga untundi. [Practice with SpeakX. Your English will improve in 15 days.]
